premises.text: Managing a digital life across many apps and connected devices requires constant phone checking
premises.evidence_span: There should be a nicer way to communicate with technology rather than checking your phone every single minute

premises.text: A wall clock with glanceable geometric display and speaker shows timely information from wearables, devices, and web services without disrupting current tasks
premises.evidence_span: Glance Clock is a well-designed wall clock with embedded glanceable display, built-in speaker, and open cloud platform

premises.text: An open cloud platform with API integrations analyzes connected data to decide what, when, and where to display, including location-relevant multi-clock setups
premises.evidence_span: we have a cloud platform with a lot of integrations that can actually integrate via open APIs

premises.text: Go-to-market uses crowdfunding then web pre-orders and retail, with a ~$149 device price and personalizable frames
premises.evidence_span: we will launch Indiegogo campaign on February this year

value.text: Needed information from connected life appears at a glance without phone disruption
value.evidence_span: read information quickly at a glance without being disrupted from your current tasks

causal_links.evidence_span: checking your phone every single minute
shows you information from your wearables, connected devices, and web services right at the moment you need it
To introduce Glance Clock to market

notes: Sleep/weather/calendar demo uses folded as applications of the glanceable+cloud mechanism (v1.5.1 §4.1.2). Pair-phone setup treated as product cascade.
